rule: first day of the month that maximizes min(previous deals, replayable current deals), ties to the earlier month; previous = ended before the cutoff (last event of any kind: email, task, quote, contract signature) and quiet for at least previous_min_quiet_days on the cutoff date; ambiguous = ended before the cutoff but quiet for fewer days (never current); current = started before it and active at or after it; replayable = current with >= 2 activities on each side

source.dataset: CRMArena-Pro B2B Salesforce org (Salesforce AI Research)
